blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — House Speaker Faustino “Bojie” Dy III expressed support on Thursday for proposals to make the national budget process more transparent, saying Filipinos have the right to know how public funds are allocated and spent. In a statement, Dy said the House is open to disclosing supporting documents for government projects, making budget deliberations more accessible to the public, and working with civil society groups to strengthen public oversight. “The people should now where their money goes, who is proposing a project, why it is needed, and who will benefit from it,” he said in Filipino.
